deviations.what: An unplanned fix was added ahead of the remaining waves: the literal OpenShell credential placeholder marker was reworded out of five tracked files, and scripts/scan-secrets.py now fails on it. Tasks t2 and t3 moved from agents runs to Claude subagents on the host.
deviations.reason: Three agents runs of t2 on the OpenCode harness failed: two because the harness read the marker and the egress proxy refused its next model request, one because of the 1 MiB write chunk. The owner chose 'Fix it first' on 2026-11-26.
